title: Martial Artist Evolution
description: Four sequential panels depict the same male character with short hair in a form-fitting outfit progressing through martial arts poses. From left to right: crouching low with hands on a glowing ring above a dark mound, executing a punch beside a scarab beetle symbol, performing a high kick on a volcanic mound with multiple glowing rings, and striking a powerful double-fist pose atop a smoking volcano with a single glowing ring.
prompt: A four-panel vertical sequence in black and white with gold accents on a dark background, showing the same determined male martial artist evolving through poses: first crouching low touching a glowing golden ring over a dark mound with energy lines, then in a forward punching stance next to a large scarab beetle symbol in the sky, then balancing in a high kick on a smoking volcanic mound surrounded by multiple glowing rings with runes, finally in a powerful victory pose with both fists raised atop a erupting volcano with one glowing ring, dramatic lighting, dynamic action, studio painting challenge style
